json_ld.description:
The JBuds Lux ANC Jelle Headphones are part of the Jelle Collection, JLab's first fashion-forward product line, developed in collaboration with Orly, one of the most iconic names in nail polish. Five shimmer shades, each one designed to coordinate directly with a matching Orly nail polish shade, so the color is as intentional as the sound.

This Royal Caviar finish is a deep navy shimmer, dark and quietly powerful, paired with a deep navy gel Orly nail polish as its mani match.

Hybrid ANC uses both exterior and interior microphones to reduce ambient noise by up to 35dB. Switch to Be Aware mode to let the world back in without taking the headphones off.

Lab Spatial Audio shapes the 40mm driver's output into a three-dimensional soundstage that wraps around the listener, paired with Hybrid ANC for a more immersive listening experience.

Form-fit earcups are shaped to the natural outline of the ear, padded with 1 inch Cloud Foam cushions. Adjustable hinges and a foldable, lightweight design support all-day wear.

Five condenser microphones with 3-mic ENC pick up voice while reducing background sound on calls.

The headphones connect over Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC codec support and a 30+ foot range, supporting the HSP, HFP, A2DP, and AVRCP protocols. A USB-C cable also supports wired charging and wired audio playback. Google Fast Pair speeds up initial setup on Android devices. Bluetooth multipoint keeps the headphones connected to two devices at once, and Wireless Share Mode lets two pairs of JBuds Lux ANC headphones share audio from one device simultaneously.

The JLab App unlocks custom EQ, ANC and Be Aware toggling, custom touch controls, and safe hearing limits. Choose from JLab Signature, Balanced, and Bass Boost EQ presets, or dial in a custom setting.

The headphones weigh 235 grams and measure 7.47 inches tall, 6.13 inches long, and 3.23 inches wide. Battery life is rated at 70 hours with ANC off or 40 hours with ANC on, with talk time rated at 40 hours. A 2.5 hour charge time and a quick charge option add 7.5 hours of playtime from a 10 minute charge. Standby time is rated at 500+ hours.

Includes: JBuds Lux ANC Headset, a USB-C charging and audio cable, and a JLab 2 year limited warranty.
